coverage: Isaac Lab noise and observation delay

findings.finding: Explicit captured observations and delayed histories permit separate feedback perturbation without changing physical state. A bounded CPU-reproducible FIFO can use an explicitly declared startup policy.
findings.direction_alignment: Continue measured physics development with live monitoring
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Synthetic noise is not sensor calibration; ideal inner-loop and contact supervision limit claims.
findings.engineering_cost: Four fixed profiles, strict evidence, live display and twelve retained missions
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-015 implements bounded position/velocity noise and 40 ms delay at fixed physics cadence
findings.verification_needed: Predeclared gates, separate truth channel, seeded reconstruction, full matrix and actual live 3D inspection

overall_recommendation: Test explicit position/velocity feedback profiles while preserving runtime, physics and mission gates.
evidence_gaps: No calibrated IMU/GNSS model or estimator
